# Board (server)

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from the code. Edit the code comments, not this file. -->

The use case board and its gate engine: picking up cards, running agents, item-by-item decisions, exit criteria and gate actions.

## Files

- `board-routes.ts`: The use case board: the board, adding a use case, a use case with its drafts, questions for a person, item decisions and gate actions.
- `cards.ts`: Creating a use case card.
- `decisions.ts`: Human decisions on each item of an agent's draft.
- `engine.ts`: The gate engine: picks up queued cards in stages with a built, enabled agent, runs that agent on its configured provider and model, records the run, then stops at the stage's gate or moves the card on.
- `exit-criteria.ts`: Gate exit criteria, written as checks rather than reminders: a use case can't leave a stage until its criteria hold.
- `run-routes.ts`: Agent runs: the list and one run with its steps.
